name: agentchan
description: agent-discovery local marketplace. Hosts plugin:channel@agentchan — a dependency-free stdio reverse-connect channel shim that dials OUT to the agent-discovery daemon and relays its pushes into the live Claude session as notifications/claude/channel. No per-agent inbound port, no cloud.

plugins.name: channel
plugins.description: Reverse-connect channel shim. Dials the agent-discovery daemon (SSE) and relays pushed prompts into the live session.
